description: This Java class models the <entity-data-reader> XML element, providing constructors to initialize from a name or an XML element, and methods to access its name and resource list.

classes.name: EntityDataReader
classes.description: A class representing the <entity-data-reader> XML element, encapsulating its name and associated resources.

methods.name: EntityDataReader(String name)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given name, throws exception if name is null or empty.

methods.name: EntityDataReader(Element element)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object from an XML Element, extracting the name and resource list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the entity data reader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of Resource objects associated with this entity data reader.
